notes: The error message no longer blames another extension. Chrome's own download history for the failed runs on 21 August shows no other extension touched those files - this one simply did not answer when Chrome asked where to put them. Saying otherwise sent the search in the wrong direction.

Copy diagnostics now records WHY each file was or was not placed, one line per download. The report could previously say a file went astray but not which of several reasons caused it, so it guessed. Run the reports once more and copy the diagnostics - that will name the cause.
